scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @tazkle/platform-contracts && npm run build -w @tazkle/service-kit
scripts.build:services: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @tazkle/identity && npm run build -w @tazkle/gateway && npm run build -w @tazkle/project-core && npm run build -w @tazkle/tazki && npm run build -w @tazkle/automation
scripts.typecheck:services: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:services: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:gateway: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @tazkle/gateway
scripts.dev:identity: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @tazkle/identity
scripts.dev:core: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @tazkle/project-core
scripts.dev:tazki: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @tazkle/tazki
scripts.dev:automation: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @tazkle/automation
